question: tell the top 5 customrers by revenue in the north region and are of vip tier
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = 'North' AND c.tier = 'VIP'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: tell me top 5 sold products and also the names of peoples top 5 who have bought these as per revenue
sql:
WITH product_rev AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM product_rev
  ORDER BY revenue DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
customer_rev AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id,
         o.customer_id,
         c.name AS customer_name,
         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY oi.product_id, o.customer_id, c.name
),
ranked_customers AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
  FROM customer_rev
  WHERE product_id IN (SELECT id FROM top_products)
)
SELECT tp.id AS product_id,
       tp.name AS product_name,
       tp.revenue AS product_revenue,
       rc.customer_id,
       rc.customer_name,
       rc.revenue AS customer_revenue
FROM top_products tp
JOIN ranked_customers rc ON rc.product_id = tp.id
WHERE rc.rn <= 5
ORDER BY tp.revenue DESC, rc.revenue DESC;

question: generate a monthly report for january month covering sales, product details, marketing, orders, returns
sql:
WITH returns_per_product AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_id = o.id
        AND r.return_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' 
        AND r.return_date <  DATE '2023-02-01'
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' 
      AND o.order_date <  DATE '2023-02-01'
    GROUP BY p.id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.category,
    s.total_quantity_sold,
    s.total_sales_amount,
    COALESCE(rp.refund_amount,0) AS total_returns_amount,
    m.total_marketing_spend
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' 
      AND o.order_date <  DATE '2023-02-01'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category
) s
LEFT JOIN returns_per_product rp ON rp.product_id = s.id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(amount_spent) AS total_marketing_spend
    FROM marketing_spend
    WHERE month >= DATE '2023-01-01' 
      AND month <  DATE '2023-02-01'
) m
ORDER BY s.total_sales_amount DESC;
